Title: Site Recovery available in Microsoft Azure Germany

Body.Content:
Azure Site Recovery is now available in the Germany Northeast and Central Azure regions.

With this expansion, customers in these regions can enjoy the reliability and performance levels set in the Site Recovery SLA.

To learn more about Site Recovery, see Getting started with Azure Site Recovery. For more information about the regional availability of the service, visit the Azure regions page.
